name: Kathmandu
tagline: Living heritage before the mountain journey
summary: Kathmandu deserves time beyond a trek’s airport transfer. Group old-city squares separately from Boudha and the western Swayambhu hill, then add Patan or Bhaktapur for a fuller valley visit.
seasonNote: Autumn often gives clearer conditions; monsoon rain affects roads and flights, while winter mornings are cool.
arrival: Use an official airport taxi or pre-arranged pickup; traffic can make short distances slow.
gettingAround: Walk heritage clusters and use hired cars between them; pavements are uneven and traffic is intense.
cashTip: Carry small Nepalese rupee notes for heritage entrances and small eateries; foreign-visitor fees differ by nationality.
foodTip: Try momo and dal bhat; ask about fillings and choose freshly cooked food.
buyTip: Seek pashmina, paper and crafts from reputable shops; bargain labels alone do not establish material quality.
baseArea: Thamel edge for logistics or Boudha for a quieter stay.
